name: neural-fly
goal: Track six laps of x=1.25 sin(t), y=0, z=1.8+0.75 sin(2t), with randomized center and initial phase, in constant and time-varying wind.
score: Crash or escape: 0. Otherwise 100 exp(-max(0,tracking_RMSE_m-0.03)/0.25); success requires full horizon and RMSE<0.25 m. Tracking uses prescribed timestamps; slowing the reference is impossible.
feedback: Video frames and noisy measurements only; no deployment scores, contacts, parameters, seeds or true state. Diagnosis is a short observation/change/prediction, not private reasoning.
limitations: Flight-log-fitted force surrogate; approximate attitude/actuator dynamics, not PX4 SITL or a DAIML reproduction.
